$meta.name: Forward Support Care Ltd brand tokens

blue.use: Primary brand colour. Headers, links, key UI elements, logo.

orange.use: Accent. Top stripe on documents, CTAs, emphasis, negative callouts, warnings, gates.

cyan.use: Secondary accent. Keyword highlights in titles, section eyebrows, tagline, positive callouts.

grey.use: Body text, captions, subtle elements, footer text.

dark.use: Dark backgrounds (covers, dividers, website hero), primary text on white.

tint.use: Light background panels, alternating table rows, subtle contrast.

hairline.use: Subtle dividers, checklist box outlines, table rules.

orangeTint.use: Background of orange callouts (negatives, warnings, gates).

blueTint.use: Background of blue callouts (context, reference notes).

printDocuments.note: Effra is commercial. Inter is the closest free alternative.

presentations.note: For internal or external slide decks.

eyebrow.accent: small vertical cyan bar in front (or orange when colour is orange)

rules: Never use more than two font weights on a single page (Regular and Bold).
Never use decorative, script, or novelty fonts anywhere.
Body text line height: 140-150% of font size.
No em dashes. House style. Use commas, full stops, or sentence breaks.

logo.reversedWhite: OUTSTANDING - see Brand_Lock.md and Brand Book Section 14
logo.clearSpace: Equal to the height of the letter F in FORWARD
rules: Always reproduce from approved artwork files.
Never recreate, redraw, or synthesise the logo in any form (no SVG, no code, no ASCII, no JPG inversion, no AI-generated).
Never place on busy or patterned backgrounds.

cover.logo: white-on-dark, top-left (BLOCKED on white logo asset)
cover.eyebrow: cyan, uppercase, letterspaced, with vertical cyan bar accent
cover.title: large white, with one keyword in cyan

divider.logo: white-on-dark, small, top-left (BLOCKED on white logo asset)
divider.eyebrow: cyan, with vertical cyan bar accent (e.g. 'SECTION 01')
divider.title: large white, with one keyword in cyan

contentPage.spec: Brand Book Section 11 written + audience PDFs as built (reconciled)
contentPage.topChrome: none. No logo at top. No header rule. Clean content from the top margin.

footer.left: Forward Support Care Ltd · Catherine House, Taunton (8pt grey)

positive.use: context, reference notes, positives, 'what we do'

negative.use: warnings, gates, required actions, 'what we don't do'

documentNumbering.appearsIn: Document reference (header), not in page chrome

businessCardBack.ground: dark navy, white logo centred, cyan tagline (BLOCKED on white logo asset)

memoTemplate.label: MEMORANDUM in blue letterspaced, internal use

whiteOnDarkLogo.status: outstanding since Brand Book v1.0 (28 April 2026)
